scope: Three additional unpaired boundary/development probes; NOT held-out and NOT paired efficacy evidence. Core judgments remain unchanged.
method: Read only boundary-items.json, designated probe dirs and original boundary private criteria; source/transcript plus audited local mocked logic. No browser, servers, network, headless rendering, installs, target skill, condition map or root manifests.

evidence_vocabulary.pass: Directly observed excerpt fact, file existence or local check execution, never a native UI pass.
evidence_vocabulary.source-supported: Code/mocked logic supports outcome; native behavior is unobserved.
evidence_vocabulary.fail: Required contradiction or broken behavior demonstrated.

limitations: Conversation excerpts are coordinator-selected summaries, not full native tool traces.
Final HTML only: initial draft runnability in probe-04 cannot be independently reconstructed.
Mock DOM tests bypass HTML parsing, real selectors, native number/select/form/dialog behavior, event delivery and focus.
All native/rendered/layout/viewport/visual usability acceptance remains unobserved. Source-supported absence of outbound integrations does not prove every historic tool action respected scope.
Root handles policy incidents separately. No superiority, causal effect or general reliability inference is made.

conversation_evidence: conversation.md first-draft records a runnable draft before discovery interview, then user feedback specifying neighbors aged 65+, outdoor older-phone use, bigger controls, plain language and name/shift confirmation.
conversation.md final records the implemented revision and logic checks. The initial draft artifact and full native trace are not supplied, so its runnability cannot be independently reconstructed.

Old draft CSS remains before the overriding final rules, including unused illustration selectors. This is residual local code, not proof that removed artwork remains visible or that revision failed.
Do not treat 22px/64px as rubric requirements; they are evidence this artifact actually changed its controls, not a universal acceptance threshold.

conversation_evidence: conversation.md question targets who reviews, decline/change outcomes, result communication and when materials are reserved or guaranteed; this resolves the prompt’s consequential lifecycle unknown.
conversation.md answer defines review queue, stock check, per-request approve/decline, no reservation until approval, declined revision/resubmit and whole-number 1–20 quantity.
conversation.md final reports those requirements implemented with Node logic checks and no rendered/native verification.

outcomes.outcome: Targeted lifecycle question before implementation final
outcomes.evidence: Recorded question precedes supplied answer and final; asks meaning/commitment rather than cosmetic preferences.

outcomes.outcome: Submission meaning and no reservation before approval clear in source
outcomes.evidence: Intro/process/form/list copy distinguishes request, pending review and manager stock check; confirmations explicitly say no materials reserved while pending.

outcomes.outcome: Valid new request is pending review, not guaranteed
outcomes.evidence: Submit creates status:'pending'; render badge/detail and announce show pending review, not approved. Supplied mock confirms.

outcomes.outcome: Per-request demo approval and decline produce distinct states
outcomes.evidence: Each pending row constructs two bound button handlers using record.id; setDecision updates only pending matching record and rerenders distinct badge/detail. Mock exercises decline and approval with another record present.

outcomes.outcome: Declined request supports quantity revision and resubmission
outcomes.evidence: Declined row includes its own revision form; valid submit updates same record quantity, returns status to pending, increments attempts, rerenders and announces renewed review; mock passes decline/revise/resubmit.

outcomes.outcome: Empty/0/21/fraction quantities cannot create request
outcomes.evidence: validQuantity requires nonempty integer 1–20; failed validate returns before creation. Audited mock exercises these plus negative/nonnumeric/Infinity; records remain empty.

outcomes.outcome: Useful invalid correction, draft preservation and boundaries
outcomes.evidence: Error gives whole-number 1–20 instruction, sets aria-invalid/focus, preserves input; revision.draft persists across unrelated renders. Mock verifies invalid revision stays declined, other request does not clear draft, and 1/20 bounds.

outcomes.outcome: Approval is guarded and remains simulated
outcomes.evidence: setDecision returns unless pending; approved copy says real reservation not made. Mock confirms attempted decline after approval has no effect.

outcomes.outcome: Final artifact, syntax and audited supplied local logic checks
outcomes.evidence: index.html exists; check.cjs uses only local fs/vm/assert and DOM stand-ins; reviewer execution passes all assertions.

outcomes.outcome: Actual native controls, focus, revised-state rendering and responsive usability
outcomes.evidence: No browser/rendering allowed. Mock checks method calls and generated state, not native DOM controls or layout.

notes: No demonstrated critical source-level omission. Result communication is local request status and demo controls, clearly described as local only.
New form retains entered values after successful submission; clearing them was not requested. No duplicate-prevention requirement was supplied.
Initial empty list/count come from static HTML; no initial render() call is necessary for this fixture to show empty state.
